description: This file defines the `Column` class in the `OrangeHRM` project, specifically within the Report Header module of the Core plugin. It provides properties and methods for configuring report columns, including pinning, naming, sizing, and cell properties.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a configurable report column with properties such as name, property identifier, pin position, size, and cell properties. Provides methods for setting and retrieving these properties, as well as converting the column to an array format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the column with a property identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the column, if set.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the column and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getProp
methods.description: Retrieves the property identifier associated with the column.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets the property identifier and returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getPin
methods.description: Returns the pin position of the column (start or end), if set.

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Sets the pin position (`colPinStart`, `colPinEnd`, or null), validates input, and returns the instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the column, if set.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the column and returns the instance.

methods.name: getCellProperties
methods.description: Retrieves additional cell properties, if any.

methods.name: setCellProperties
methods.description: Sets multiple cell properties at once, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: addCellProperties
methods.description: Merges new cell properties into existing ones and returns the instance.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the Column object into an associative array of its properties.
